title: Quickly Steamed Turkish Galangal-Kha Wrap
description: Fresh, gooey monsoon Turkish dish featuring sashimi-cut galangal-kha wrapped in ti-leaf. Diabetic-friendly option for a quick and healthy meal.

ingredients.name: ti leaf wraps
ingredients.notes: large, tender ti leaves for wrapping

ingredients.name: galangal-kha
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced galangal-kha for sashimi-style cut

ingredients.name: turkish red pepper flake
ingredients.notes: hot and spicy, adjust to taste

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.notes: freshly squeezed for a burst of citrus

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil
ingredients.notes: healthy fat for finishing the dish

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use a flaky sea salt for added texture

instructions: Prepare ti leaf wraps by rinsing and gently pat-drying with paper towels.
Slice the galangal-kha into thin, sashimi-style cuts and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together turkish red pepper flake and lemon juice.
Heat the extra virgin olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add the galangal-kha to the skillet and sauté for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly softened.
Add the turkish red pepper flake and lemon juice mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt to taste, then remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly.
To assemble the wraps, lay a ti leaf flat and add a portion of the galangal-kha mixture to the center.
Fold the bottom half of the ti leaf up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Serve immediately, garnished with a few sprigs of fresh mint leaves.
